Source image shows a white and rose-gold body with LED display, temperature control, ceramic-coated plates, lockable handle, a 2600 mAh battery label and a USB charging port. Pending supplier confirmation: temperature range, heat-up time, battery run time, plate width, charging time, voltage, safety certifications and package contents. products.nameEn: Mud Mask & Soap Bar Cleansing Set
products.facts: Supplier title: Acne Care Bundle (renamed to avoid a skin-condition claim). Supplier text: kit with a mud and arnica mask (powder, mixed with water), a soap bar with a natural loofah and hanging cord, and a natural loofah set of 5 pieces. Soap ingredients named: chia, lemon, parsley and coconut oil. Directions in the source: lather the soap bar under water, apply and massage gently in circular motions, avoid the eyes; for the mask, mix 2 tsp of powder with enough water to make a paste. Source image is a promotional graphic with text over a pouch of mask and arnica flowers. Pending supplier confirmation: full ingredient lists, product sizes and weights, remaining mask directions, shelf life, labeling and cosmetic import compliance. Supplier text makes acne, pore and skin-result claims that are not repeated here.

Source image also shows a before-and-after lash comparison that is not repeated here.
